DuplicateCase.Title: Boundary Value Analysis: Sensor D2 at Lower Boundary for WATER Detection
DuplicateCase.Description: Test the gripper behavior when sensor D2 detects exactly 249 units, which is just below the 250-unit threshold for WATER product identification.
DuplicateCase.Objective: Validate system response at boundary condition of 249 units
DuplicateCase.Comments: Confirm correct handling at edge case of lower limit

MatchedWith.Title: Core Functional Test: Gripper Behavior for WATER Product Detection
MatchedWith.Description: Verify that the gripper correctly identifies and responds to a WATER product when sensor D2 detects less than 250 units, ensuring proper state transition to WATER.
MatchedWith.Objective: Validate correct gripper behavior and system state transition for WATER product detection
MatchedWith.Comments: Ensure gripper action aligns with WATER product type requirements

DuplicateCase.Title: Verify System Response to No Product Detected by Sensor D2
DuplicateCase.Description: Validate that the system correctly identifies a NONE product type when sensor D2 does not detect any product, ensuring the gripper remains open and appropriate status is logged.
DuplicateCase.Objective: Ensure correct identification of NONE product type when sensor D2 fails to detect an object
DuplicateCase.Comments: Precondition: Sensor D2 must be simulated as inactive or returning no detection signal
